clips.title: The story
paras: At Darnassus's eastern edge, Sentinels patrol the Warrior's Terrace and its fortified gate. The district houses battlemasters and warrior trainers, with open plazas for drills and duels overlooking the road into greater Teldrassil.

Sentinels guard Darnassus at the Warrior's Terrace, also called the Hall of Justice. Mounted on nightsabers, they watch the high arched gates for travelers coming from the Teldrassil wilds. In the open-air plazas, aspiring combatants drill beside seasoned veterans on dueling grounds and target ranges. Weapon smiths and armorers meet practical military needs, while battlemasters coordinate night elf forces across the wider world.
